purpose: Проверить, что замена существующей реализации не создаёт бессрочный параллельный legacy path и сохраняет совместимость через ограниченную миграцию.
prompt:
<assignment>
role: solution-architect
mode: design
target: health synchronization bridge replacement
solution_horizon: bounded-systemic
</assignment>

<source_documents>
<document id="SRC-001" origin="repository">Legacy health bridge owns eight public endpoints and the current business rules. A new health-sync owner already covers the confirmed target capability.</document>
<document id="SRC-002" origin="compatibility-contract">Existing mobile clients require the old endpoint shape for one release. Contract translation is allowed; new business rules must live only in the new owner.</document>
<document id="SRC-003" origin="release-policy">The old endpoint can be removed after supported clients migrate and rollback is no longer required.</document>
</source_documents>

<final_instruction>
Верни solution-boundary schema 2. Выбери переходный режим, обозначь authority/cutover/rollback/retirement и не расширяй подтверждённый scope.
</final_instruction>

required_actions: choose staged-migration because bounded compatibility evidence requires temporary coexistence
inventory the legacy bridge as a superseded path
name one authoritative owner for every migration stage
bound the old endpoint to contract translation only
define rollback boundary and measurable retirement trigger
forbidden_actions: keep both implementations without a cutover plan
add new business rules to the legacy bridge
create adapters independently in every caller
delete the compatibility path before the supported-client boundary
treat eight endpoints alone as proof of a defect

allowed_research_exception.condition: only when caller or compatibility evidence cannot identify authority or safe cutover
